name: Bitbird
detailed_description:
Alka is a young bird who lives at the top of the Tree of Eternity. One day, she loses her balance and falls, waking up in a strange and dangerous place. To return home, she must overcome the obstacles in her path. Help Alka on her journey and guide her back to her nest.

Three Different Art Styles

Each world offers a unique visual experience with its own distinct design, creating a strong and memorable artistic impact.

Unique and Challenging Levels

Every level presents a unique experience and a new challenge for the player. With varying difficulty levels, gameplay dynamics, and environment designs, these levels offer a constantly evolving pace and fresh experience.

Accessible Gameplay, Deep Mechanics

Players can quickly adapt to the core mechanic; however, mastering it takes time and practice. The system is built on a foundation that’s easy to learn but hard to master.

Gravity Rotation Mechanic

The Gravity Rotation Mechanic allows you to shift gravity to the left, right, up, or down. This turns walls into paths and ceilings into floors. Each level utilizes this mechanic in a different way, offering new solutions and keeping the game’s pace fresh and exciting.

short_description: Bitbird is a 2D platformer where players manipulate gravity to overcome challenging levels. The game starts with monochrome pixel-art and evolves through 4-bit, 8-bit, and 16-bit styles inspired by different gaming eras.
